name: varyform-3d-configurator
description: VARYFORM — Parametric 3D Product Configurator. Configure. Visualize. Manufacture.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev --workspace @varyform/web" "npm run dev --workspace @varyform/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @varyform/api && npm run build --workspace @varyform/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @varyform/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @varyform/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @varyform/api && npm run lint --workspace @varyform/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @varyform/domain && npm run test --workspace @varyform/api
